title: Jamaican Steak Skillet
description: Quick and delicious Jamaican inspired steak skillet recipe with a flavorful blend of spices.
instructions: Season the steak with jerk seasoning and dust with flour.
Heat coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the steak for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Remove the steak from the skillet and set aside.
Add sliced onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until tender.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add cherry tomatoes and cook until they start to release their juices.
Return the steak to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the steak reaches an internal temperature of 135°F for medium-rare.
Remove the skillet from the heat and let the steak rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the steak with the vegetables and sauce from the skillet.
